name: demo-fixture-placement
body: source: user-approved addition of solution.component.demo-fixture (examples/demo/ non-EY demo project used by integration tests + e2e harness; distinct from init-seed). Placement: contained by solution.container.release-pipeline, alongside native-e2e-ci (the repo test/CI artifact container), not cli-binary (demo is not embedded, unlike init-seed). Realised from domain.entity.template-library (the entity requirements.requirement.demo-project drives; existing realisations template-library-loader and http-server kept). inconsistency: requested uses/depends-on edges demo-fixture -> template-library-loader and native-e2e-ci -> demo-fixture are refused by the schema (uses only person->system; depends-on only requirement->requirement). resolution: relationships recorded here instead — demo-fixture is loaded by template-library-loader (it must be a valid library for it), and native-e2e-ci / integration tests consume demo-fixture as their fixture.
